chunks: Apart from those to whom God is kind. He is all-mighty and all-merciful.

key_terms.الرَّحِيمُ: The Merciful, The Bestower of Mercy

ai.seo_question: Who is exempt from the punishment mentioned in the context of Surah Al-Dukhan?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the transition from divine retribution to mercy, emphasizing that salvation is ultimately contingent upon Allah's grace rather than mere endurance of the trial. The juxtaposition of Al-Aziz (The Mighty) and Al-Rahim (The Merciful) underscores that God's power is the foundation of His ability to forgive, a concept central to the Shia understanding of divine justice and mercy.
